games.title: Mướp và Mười Hai Ngọn Đèn
games.blurb: A ginger cat carries the last spark through one long day, from morning hills to an aurora peak, to relight twelve lanterns.

games.title: Tím 4
games.blurb: Notebook pages of a hand-drawn platformer, inked in purple and rebuilt as levels you can really play.

games.title: Medieval Mayhem II
games.kind: Card battle, you against up to 3 AI rivals
games.blurb: Pick a civilization and outlast the table. Every card is a unit, and everything it does is printed in its symbols.

games.title: Mayhem Classic
games.kind: Card battle, you against up to 3 AI rivals
games.blurb: Four heroes, ten hit points each. Draw a card, play a card, and be the last one standing. Plays by the Dungeon Mayhem rules.

games.title: Masks & Mortar
games.kind: City building with cards, you against up to 7 AI rivals
games.blurb: Each round, secretly take a character, gather gold and build districts. The finest city wins. Plays by the Citadels rules.

games.title: Lên Đời
games.kind: Turn-based strategy, you against the AI
games.blurb: Medieval empires on a small map. Both sides give their orders in secret, then reveal them at the same moment.

games.title: Ông Trùm 4rum
games.blurb: It is 2007 and you run a fan forum. Clear the spam, calm the drama and keep the boards alive until Facebook arrives.

games.title: Saltline
games.blurb: A first-person shooter in a single HTML file: a container port at dawn, three uplinks of a security net to cut, then the boat. Not a Sonic Hub game: found on the web and kept as a reference for vibe coding. The file names no author.
